channel.title: On-Device-Ai on Junho Lee
channel.description: Recent content in On-Device-Ai on Junho Lee

item.title: Google AI Edge Foresight: A Free On-Device AI Meeting Notes App for Mac
item.description: Google’s experimental Mac app AI Edge Foresight transcribes meetings, expands notes, and searches local documents entirely on-device using EmbeddingGemma 2 and Gemma 4.

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: On-Device Multimodal Search in One Vector Space
item.description: Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2 maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a shared 768-dimensional space with optional encoders for on-device search.

item.title: batisay: Free On-Device Korean Speech-to-Text Tuned for Apple Silicon
item.description: batisay fine-tunes Whisper large-v3-turbo on 4,300 hours of conversational Korean and runs locally on MacBooks via whisper.cpp and Apple Silicon Metal acceleration.

item.title: Mac Whisper: On-Device Push-to-Talk Voice Dictation via the Fn Key
item.description: Mac Whisper is an open-source macOS dictation tool triggered by holding the Fn key, with version 0.0.4 cutting CPU overhead and adding optional LLM cleanup.

item.title: CamLoop: On-Device AI Virtual Camera for Stepping Away Mid-Meeting
item.description: CamLoop uses ping-pong looping, on-device pose alignment, frame morphing, and exposure checks on macOS so users can step away smoothly on video calls.

item.title: Anf: Native AppKit macOS File Browser with On-Device AI
item.description: Anf pairs native AppKit rendering and getattrlistbulk(2) speed to load 26,000 folders in 0.1s alongside built-in SFTP, terminal, and AI tools.
